run_riemannian_gnn: run a Riemannian GNN model for graph prediction tasks like QM8, QM9, or ZINC
parse_default_args: parse command line arguments for Riemannian GNN tasks including manifold selection and distributed training
create_manifold: create a Poincare, Lorentz, or Euclidean manifold object based on the selected manifold type
set_up_fold: set up cross-validation fold file paths for DD, enzymes, proteins, reddit, or collab tasks
add_embed_size: add one to the embedding size when using the Lorentz manifold for degree of freedom
